=== a copy of a connected project
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
onboard-project: <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy/.agent-memory 裡的筆記不是這個資料夾的(<TMP>/home/workspace/alpha/.git):它看起來是另一個專案的複本,接上會把那個專案的筆記接走。要把它接成獨立的專案,先移除複製過來的筆記(另一個專案自己的會留著),再跑一次:
  rm -rf <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy/.agent-memory <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy/.git/worktrees/-agent-memory; git -C <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy branch -D agent-memory

=== a moved project
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
onboard-project: <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy/.agent-memory 指到的 repo 不在了(/gone/.git/worktrees/.agent-memory)。如果這個資料夾搬過家,先跑 git -C <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy worktree repair .agent-memory,再跑一次這個

=== inside another repo
exit 1

--- stderr
